purpose: falsifiability audit for the mid-gate reload detector, before the corrected implementation is used in a real gate run
mutation_method: each case mutates the OBSERVATION TIMELINE the detector reads, and the row asserts the mutation actually changed those bytes before checking the verdict

rows.mutation: baseline: unloaded → one initial load during probe 1 → resident for probes 2 and 3
rows.reason: at most one initial load; the same resident model served every remaining planned probe

rows.mutation: probe 2's BEFORE sample is flipped to unloaded, modelling an unload between probe 1 and probe 2
rows.reason: the model was UNLOADED at probe_2:before (observed after probe_1:after)

rows.mutation: probes 2 and 3 carry a DIFFERENT model digest
rows.reason: the model digest CHANGED at probe_2:before (6488c96fa5fa… → 111111111111…)

rows.mutation: baseline: resident from before probe 1 and never unloaded
rows.reason: at most one initial load; the same resident model served every remaining planned probe

rows.mutation: probe 2's BEFORE sample is flipped to unloaded, modelling a second load
rows.reason: the model was UNLOADED at probe_2:before (observed after probe_1:after)

known_limit: a silent unload-and-reload completing entirely between two sample points while ending resident is not observable by this detector; that limit is recorded in the detector's own detection_scope field
